Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1274

Christopher Wong
4-25-24
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision. The insured driver reports the other vehicle corssed
into their lane, and the claimant is represented by counsel who has requested that all contact go through their office.
6-11-24
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and was covered on the date of the loss. Nothing in the
file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage.
6-22-24
Inspected the vehicle and photographed the front-end damage. The damage pattern matches the impact as
described, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior records.
7-12-24
Police report and statements from the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
Photos from the scene confirm some details of the account, although no independent witnesses have come forward.
8-21-24
The claimant's medical records report whiplash. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this severity. Records
also show a small strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully, so the prior history has been noted.
9-1-24
Counsel supplied a supplemental statement with some added details. The core account has not changed from the
original report, and the additions are minor and consistent with it.
10-6-24
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. Based on the records, the file is moving
toward a reasonable evaluation of the injury claim, with ongoing review of the treatment notes.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
